description: Opt-in Mnemosyne OS desktop-app memory and dashboard. Replace MNEMO_VAULTS with approved vault names before enabling; the app ingests selected folders into persistent vaults, and memory_ingest can save content for later agents. Vault scope does not restrict session tools, which read local coding-agent transcripts. Review folder and transcript access before enabling. Memory tools use the app at ws://127.0.0.1:7799. Tool results, including private memory and session data, go to the MCP client and its model provider. Version 2.4.0 adds mnemosyne_telegram_send, which uploads a local media or PDF file to the Telegram chat configured in the app, and on macOS mnemosyne_mac_update_install, which downloads the latest GitHub release and replaces the installed app; require client approval for both, or deny them if unused. Not enabled by default.
name: mnemosyne-os
